title: Muzyamba v Sinabbomba and Ors (Appeal 11 of 2019) [2020] ZMSC 130 (4 September 2020)
issue_tags: exclusion of limitation where beneficiary alleges fraud or fraudulent breach of trust; constructive trust where administrator acquires title; administrators' fiduciary duties and prohibition on selling estate property without court authority (Intestate Succession Act); bona fide purchaser for value without notice defence; dismissal for being statute‑barred reversed and matter remitted for trial.
outcome_detail: Section 19(1) excludes limitation where beneficiaries allege trustee fraud; appellant’s claim held not statute‑barred and remitted for trial
